decisions.gainTrust: Move {piece} to {destination}; use political presence to gain ${terms.playerTracks.trust}
decisions.removeScrutiny: Move {piece} to {destination}; use political presence to remove ${terms.playerTracks.scrutiny}
decisions.proposeJointVenture: Propose a Joint Venture to seat {seat}
decisions.socialGraphDeploy: ${terms.actions.deploy} remotely through The Social Graph to {destination}
decisions.reorganizeReturn: Return one Team, gain 3 ${terms.resources.runway}, and add 1 ${terms.playerTracks.scrutiny}
decisions.allocationWait: Keep Allocation Window available for a later cycle
decisions.emergencyPauseWait: Do not invoke Emergency Pause this cycle
decisions.tradeNone: Do not trade during this resolution
decisions.trainingCuratedDomain: Treat Curated Corpus as the missing {domain} domain

decisions.trainingProtectResearchVisit: Use the ${terms.locations.research} visit, discard the duplicate, and bank
decisions.trainingProtectScientificMethod: Pay {cost} ${terms.resources.runway} for Scientific Method, discard the duplicate, and bank
decisions.trainingAcceptCrash: Accept the crash and lose provisional ${terms.playerTracks.capability}
decisions.trainingEmergencyPause: Play Emergency Pause; end with no provisional ${terms.playerTracks.capability} and no crash ${terms.playerTracks.scrutiny}
decisions.trainingBank: Bank {capability} provisional ${terms.playerTracks.capability} and end the Training Run
decisions.trainingContinue: Risk {capability} provisional ${terms.playerTracks.capability} and reveal another card
decisions.moveAdditionalStep: Move {piece} one adjacent step to {destination}; {remaining} steps remain

decisions.returnNoTeams: Return no Teams under the Headline
decisions.reorganizationTeamDestination: Move {team} up to one hex to {destination}
